GOV-F-004-S136.title: Audit Log Storage Layer (Append-Only Collection + Indexing)
GOV-F-004-S136.description: Implement MongoDB collection for audit logs with append-only enforcement (no update/delete operations allowed via service layer), including indexes on trace_id, timestamp, and actor. Ensure write path only allows inserts and rejects mutations.
GOV-F-004-S136.evidence: Code/Shared/ChatHealthyMongoUtilities.py (Mongo patterns); Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/infrastructure/debug_logger.py (existing logging persistence); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S137.title: Hash Chain Integrity Service
GOV-F-004-S137.description: Implement hash chaining for audit records where each record stores a hash of its contents and the previous record’s hash. Provide utility to compute, validate, and detect breaks in the chain for tamper evidence.
GOV-F-004-S137.evidence: docs/adr/ADR-0010-safety-incident-logging.md (logging integrity precedent); Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py (audit logging reference); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S138.title: Audit Event Contract Enforcement in Tool Router
GOV-F-004-S138.description: Extend tool_router to enforce emission of standardized audit events for every tool invocation, including input validation results, tool selection, and execution outcome. Reject execution if audit emission fails.
GOV-F-004-S138.evidence: Code/ConversationalUX/FindCareChat/backend/application/tool_router.py (central dispatch + GOV-004 allowlist); RECORD sprint_plan/backlog_0_1_4_perplexity BL-0.1.4-004

GOV-F-004-S139.title: Audit Logging for Safety and Consent Critical Events
GOV-F-004-S139.description: Instrument safety_service and consent_service to emit high-priority audit records for emergency detection, session locks, consent capture, and de-identification actions, ensuring traceability of compliance-critical flows.
